vibe_rationale: Deep, purist dance-music community with heavy curation since 2001 and a secret lineup, but a single scene with very low commercial presence.
fit_notes: Adult (18+) camping techno crowd with a strong community, but weak wellness adjacency and a strong anti-branding culture make brands hard to reach. Only a quiet service such as hydration, rest or recovery would fit, and partners so far are sound and rental suppliers. Japan-based.
